Clinical Departments

Comprehensive care for every need

Orthopaedics & Spine

Treatment for bone, joint, muscle and spine problems, from sports injuries to complex surgeries.

  • Knee and hip replacement
  • Trauma and fracture care
  • Spine surgery
  • Arthroscopy and sports injury
View doctors Book visit

Cardiology

Complete heart care with a Cath Lab, expert cardiologists and round-the-clock monitoring.

  • Angiography and angioplasty
  • ECG, Echo and TMT
  • Heart attack emergency care
  • Hypertension and heart failure
View doctors Book visit

Neurology & Neurosurgery

Diagnosis and treatment of brain, spine and nerve disorders by experienced specialists.

  • Stroke and paralysis care
  • Epilepsy and migraine
  • Head injury management
  • Brain and spine surgery
View doctors Book visit

Gastroenterology

Care for the digestive system, liver and pancreas with advanced endoscopic procedures.

  • Endoscopy and colonoscopy
  • Liver and gallbladder disease
  • Acidity, ulcer and IBS
  • Pancreas disorders
View doctors Book visit

Obstetrics & Gynaecology

Safe, respectful care for women at every stage, from pregnancy to menopause.

  • Antenatal and delivery care
  • High-risk pregnancy
  • Laparoscopic gynae surgery
  • Infertility consultation
View doctors Book visit

Paediatrics

Gentle, specialised care for newborns, infants, children and adolescents.

  • Newborn and NICU care
  • Vaccination
  • Child growth and nutrition
  • Childhood infections and asthma
View doctors Book visit

General Medicine

First point of care for fevers, infections and long-term conditions, with timely referral when needed.

  • Diabetes and thyroid care
  • Fever and infections
  • Preventive health check-ups
  • ICU and critical care
View doctors Book visit

ENT

Diagnosis and surgery for ear, nose and throat problems in adults and children.

  • Sinus and nasal surgery
  • Hearing and ear problems
  • Tonsil and throat care
  • Endoscopic ENT procedures
